slot_scores.name: unknown_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the objective; it immediately declared READY_TO_MODEL and silently assumed the objective was to minimize total cost including fixed setup and variable production costs.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The objective is to minimize total cost including fixed setup costs and variable unit production costs.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked or confirmed the objective with the user; it inferred it from the brief and stated it as part of its READY_TO_MODEL summary.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL immediately without asking any clarifying questions, leaving the P0 objective slot unresolved.

summary: The agent skipped clarification entirely and immediately declared READY_TO_MODEL, silently assuming the objective was to minimize total cost. This left the P0 hidden objective slot unresolved, making the stop premature.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
